cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Select, organize and look after something
cards.auxiliaryText2: ex.: The Miraikan curates three or more special interactive exhibitions each year.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: A temporary emotional state or the way someone feels emotionally.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She is in a good mood today.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Relaxed and not worried or stressed.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I like to stay chilled out on weekends.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Somewhat; to a moderate degree, but not completely.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I am somewhat tired after work.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Not easy to do, understand, or deal with.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: English grammar is difficult for me.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Not requiring much effort; simple to do or understand.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: It is easy to maneuver this small car.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: To a fairly large degree; moderately.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: My routine is fairly simple.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: To take off or remove something, especially clothing or footwear.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Take your coat off because it is warm inside.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Used to introduce a preference or offer an alternative.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Would you rather have tea or coffee?

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: To behave toward someone in a particular way; also, a special event or occasion.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Treat others with respect.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: The act of accepting something or someone; approval or agreement.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Her acceptance of the job offer made her very happy.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: To make someone feel unhappy, anxious, or worried; a feeling of emotional disturbance.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She was upset when she heard the bad news.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: To express dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Stop complaining and help me clean the kitchen.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: To throw something forcefully through the air.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The angry teacher threw the pen across the room.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: To make a great effort to do something difficult or to fight against a problem.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I struggle with English grammar, but I keep practicing.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: The physical or mental energy needed to do something; hard work.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Learning English takes time and effort.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Having a high level of knowledge or skill in a particular field.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She is a leading expert in technology.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Despite the fact that; used to introduce a contrast.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Although it was raining, they went for a walk.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: A piece of writing on a particular subject, usually presenting ideas or arguments.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I have to write an essay about climate change.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Feeling confident and certain about something; not worried or doubtful.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I am so relieved to hear that you are safe.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Extremely attractive, charming, or fascinating.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She has a captivating smile that everyone notices.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Up to a particular time or event; until that moment.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I will stay here till tomorrow.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Happening very quickly and unexpectedly.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Suddenly, the lights went out.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: For that reason; as a result.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: It was raining; therefore, we stayed at home.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Filled with many people or things close together.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The subway is always crowded during rush hour.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Extremely impressive, beautiful, or surprising; inspiring wonder.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The night sky was a wondrous sight.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: To express strong approval or admiration for someone or something.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The teacher praised the student for her excellent work.

cards.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
cards.titleAnswer: Of that kind; similar to the thing or person mentioned.
cards.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset.
